### Libraries and Paths


### Load Input Data

```{r load-data}
sequenced.samples <- read.table(file.path(data_dir, "20191115_targeted_pairs.txt"),sep="\t", header=T)
# target.maf <- read.maf(maf = file.path(data_dir, "20191115_PCGA_Targeted_with_MuTect2PON.maf"))
pcga.annot <- read_xlsx(file.path(data_dir, "20240802-PCGA-01-Metadata-New.xlsx"))

target.dat <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "20250810_PCGA_Targeted_with_MuTect2PON.maf"))
target.dat$Tumor_Sample_Barcode <- substr(target.dat$Tumor_Sample_Barcode,1,30)

target.maf <- ReadMaf(maf = target.dat, metadata = pcga.annot)

# RNA-seq cohort metadata
pcga.rna.annotation <- read.table(file.path(data_dir, "GSE109743_SAMPLES.txt"), sep="\t", row.names=1, header=T)

# reading the mRNA expression matrix
pcga.rnaseq <- read.table(file.path(data_dir, "GSE109743_exp_count.txt"), sep="\t", header=T, row.names=1)

notch.pathway.genes <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "notch.pathway.genes.rds"))
```

### Data Harmonization

```{r harmonization}
pcga.annot <- DataFrame(pcga.annot)
pcga.rnaseq.annot <- DataFrame(pcga.rna.annotation, rownames(pcga.rna.annotation))

# summarized experiment object of mRNA exp matrix
pcga.rnaseq.se <- SummarizedExperiment(assays = SimpleList(counts=as.matrix(pcga.rnaseq)), 
                                       colData = pcga.rnaseq.annot)

# Subset to high-quality data and endobronchial biopsies
pcga.biopsy <- pcga.rnaseq.se[,intersect(which(colData(pcga.rnaseq.se)$characteristics..passed.QC==TRUE),
                                         which(colData(pcga.rnaseq.se)$source.name=="endobronchial biopsy"))]

pcga.biopsy@colData$histology <- pcga.annot$Histology[match(substr(colData(pcga.biopsy)$title,1,30),
                                                            pcga.annot$Tumor_Sample_Barcode)]

# Find samples the overlap RNA-seq and target-seq
overlapping.samples <- intersect(substr(colData(pcga.biopsy)$title,1,30),
                                 substr(sequenced.samples$CASE_ID,1,30))

# RNA IDs for overlapping samples
overlapping.samples.RNAID <- colData(pcga.biopsy)$title[match(overlapping.samples,
                                                              substr(colData(pcga.biopsy)$title,1,30))]

# DNA IDs for overlapping samples
overlapping.samples.DNAID <- sequenced.samples$CASE_ID[match(overlapping.samples,
                                                             substr(sequenced.samples$CASE_ID,1,30))]

# Subset gene expression matrix to include overlapping samples only
pcga.biopsy <- pcga.biopsy[, match(overlapping.samples.RNAID, colData(pcga.biopsy)$title)]
notch.maf <- subsetMaf(maf = target.maf, tsb = substr(overlapping.samples.DNAID,1,30), genes = c("NOTCH1"), query = "tumor_f >= 0.01")
notch.maf.samples <- getSampleSummary(notch.maf)

rownames(pcga.annot) <- pcga.annot$Tumor_Sample_Barcode

smoking.status <- pcga.annot[substr(overlapping.samples.RNAID,1,30), "Genomic_Smoking_Status"]
smoking.status <- factor(smoking.status,levels = c("Former","Current"))

progression.status <- pcga.annot[substr(overlapping.samples.RNAID,1,30), "Outcome"]
progression.status <- as.factor(progression.status)
```

### Data Filtration

```{r filtration}
data.dge <- DGEList(counts=assays(pcga.biopsy)$counts)

# Scale Normalization using GLM
data.dge <- calcNormFactors(data.dge,method = "TMM")

# log-transformed, library-size-adjusted expression matrix
data.cpm <- cpm(data.dge, log = TRUE)
test1 <- apply(data.cpm, 1, IQR) # interquartile range (IQR) for each gene across samples
test2 <- apply(data.cpm, 1, sum)

# genes with IQR = 0, or genes with total expression <=1 are uninformative (have no variability)
low.genes <- union(which(test1 == 0), which(test2 <= 1))
gene.ind <- setdiff(1:nrow(data.cpm), low.genes)

# remove the lowly expressed genes and calculate the norm factor again
data.dge.filtered <- data.dge[gene.ind, keep.lib.sizes = F] # recalculate library sizes
data.dge.filtered <- calcNormFactors(data.dge.filtered, method = "TMM")
data.cpm.filtered <- cpm(data.dge.filtered, log = TRUE) # log2 transformed counts per million values of filtered genes
```

### Differential Expression through Linear Mixed-Effects Model

```{r linear-model}
notch.status <- rep("WT", length = ncol(data.dge.filtered))
notch.status[match(notch.maf.samples$Tumor_Sample_Barcode,
                   substr(colData(pcga.biopsy)$title, 1, 30))] <- "MT"
notch.status <- factor(notch.status, levels = c("WT","MT"))

design <- model.matrix(~as.numeric(colData(pcga.biopsy)$characteristics..median.TIN) + 
                         as.factor(as.character(colData(pcga.biopsy)$characteristics..flowcell.ID)) + 
                         as.factor(smoking.status) + as.factor(notch.status))

v <- voom(data.dge.filtered, design = design)

pat.block <- as.factor(as.character(colData(pcga.biopsy)$characteristics..patient.ID))
dupcor <- duplicateCorrelation(v, design, block = pat.block)
print(dupcor$consensus.correlation)

# linear model
fit <- lmFit(v, design, block = pat.block, correlation = dupcor$consensus.correlation)
fit <- eBayes(fit)

result <- topTable(fit, coef = ncol(fit), adjust.method = "fdr", number = nrow(data.dge.filtered))
# joint smoking + notch effect. smoking is the second-to-last term and notch the last term
result.1 <- topTable(fit, coef = c(ncol(fit)-1, ncol(fit)), adjust.method = "fdr", number = nrow(data.dge.filtered))
# significant genes identified in DEG analysis
sig.result <- result[which(result$adj.P.Val<0.05 & abs(result$logFC) >= log2(1.25)),]

#compute residual gene expression for heatmap plotting
design.r <- model.matrix(~as.numeric(colData(pcga.biopsy)$characteristics..median.TIN) + 
                           as.factor(as.character(colData(pcga.biopsy)$characteristics..flowcell.ID)) +
                           as.factor(smoking.status))

v.r <- voom(data.dge.filtered, design = design.r)
dupcor.r <- duplicateCorrelation(v.r, design.r, block = pat.block)
print(dupcor.r$consensus.correlation)

fit.r <- lmFit(v.r, design.r, block = pat.block, correlation = dupcor.r$consensus.correlation)
fit.r <- eBayes(fit.r)
residuals <- residuals(fit.r, v.r)
```

### DEG Heatmap

```{r heatmap-prep}
mt.types <- as.matrix(notch.maf.samples[,2:(ncol(notch.maf.samples)-1)])
rownames(mt.types) <- as.matrix(notch.maf.samples[,1])
M <- mt.types

mt.types[M>=1] <- "YES"
mt.types[M==0] <- "NO"
mt.types.all <- matrix("NO",nrow=ncol(residuals),ncol=ncol(mt.types))

rownames(mt.types.all) <- colnames(residuals)

mt.types.all[match(substr(rownames(mt.types),1,30),substr(colData(pcga.biopsy)$title,1,30)),] <- mt.types

colnames(mt.types.all) <- colnames(mt.types)

mt.types.all <- as.data.frame(mt.types.all)

mt.types.all <- mt.types.all %>% mutate(priority = case_when(
  Nonsense_Mutation == "YES" | Frame_Shift_Del == "YES" | Frame_Shift_Ins == "YES" ~ "lof",
  Splice_Site == "YES" ~ "splice.site",
  Missense_Mutation == "YES" ~ "missense",
  TRUE ~ "none"
))

mt.count <- rep(0,length=ncol(data.dge.filtered))
mt.count[match(notch.maf.samples$Tumor_Sample_Barcode,
               substr(colData(pcga.biopsy)$title,1,30))] <- notch.maf.samples$total

mat_col <- data.frame(notch.status = as.factor(notch.status), mt.count = mt.count,
                      notch.mt.type = as.factor(mt.types.all$priority),
                      mol.subtype = as.factor(as.character(colData(pcga.biopsy)$characteristics..molecular.subtype)),
                      histology = gsub(" ",".",as.factor(as.character(colData(pcga.biopsy)$characteristics..dysplasia.grade))),
                      smoking.status = as.factor(smoking.status),
                      progression.status = as.factor(progression.status))

rownames(mat_col) = colnames(pcga.biopsy)

normalized.data <- t(scale(t(residuals[rownames(sig.result),]), center = T, scale = T)) # z-score, standardize each gene (mean = 0, sd = 1)

# Perform PCA
n <- normalized.data
n <- t(n) # sample by gene matrix
sample_pca <- prcomp(n) # pca on rows (samples)

head(sample_pca$rotation)[,"PC1"]
pc1 <- sample_pca$x[,"PC1"]
pc1 <- sort(pc1, decreasing = TRUE)

mat_col1 <- mat_col[match(names(pc1),row.names(mat_col)), ]
normalized.data1 <- normalized.data[,match(names(pc1),colnames(normalized.data))] # samples are ordered left-to-right in decreasing PC1 value

# to avoid extreme color scaling in the heatmap, z-scores are truncated to lie in [-2,2]
normalized.data1[normalized.data1 < -2] <- -2
normalized.data1[normalized.data1 > 2] <- 2
```

### Helper Functions: GSVA Modeling and Plotting

```{r gsva-helpers}
run_gsva_model <- function(exprData, geneSets, design_full, design_reduced, pat_block, id_col){
  gsva_param <- gsvaParam(
    exprData = exprData,
    geneSets = geneSets,
    kcdf = "Gaussian",
    minSize = 1, maxSize = 260, maxDiff = TRUE)
  
  gsva_results <- gsva(gsva_param, verbose = FALSE)
  
  # model 1: associations between gene sets and predictors (smoking, notch status),
  # adjusting for technical covariates
  dupcor <- duplicateCorrelation(gsva_results, design = design_full, block = pat_block)
  fit <- lmFit(object = gsva_results, design = design_full, block = pat_block, correlation = dupcor$consensus.correlation)
  fit <- eBayes(fit)
  
  smoking_coef <- match("smoking.statusCurrent", colnames(fit$coefficients))
  notch_coef   <- match("notch.statusMT", colnames(fit$coefficients))
  
  # move rownames (feature IDs) into a leading column before returning
  add_id_col <- function(tbl){
    tbl[[id_col]] <- rownames(tbl)
    tbl[, c(id_col, setdiff(colnames(tbl), id_col))]
  }
  
  sig.result <- topTable(fit = fit, coef = c(smoking_coef, notch_coef),
                         adjust.method = "fdr", number = nrow(gsva_results)) |>
    filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05) |> add_id_col()
  
  smoking.only <- topTable(fit = fit, coef = smoking_coef,
                           adjust.method = "fdr", number = nrow(gsva_results)) |>
    filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05) |> add_id_col()
  
  notch.only <- topTable(fit = fit, coef = notch_coef,
                         adjust.method = "fdr", number = nrow(gsva_results)) |>
    filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05) |> add_id_col()
  
  # model 2: remove effects of technical covariates only, to visualize the underlying
  # biological (smoking/notch) signal
  dupcor.r <- duplicateCorrelation(gsva_results, design = design_reduced, block = pat_block)
  fit.r <- lmFit(gsva_results, design = design_reduced, block = pat_block, correlation = dupcor.r$consensus.correlation)
  fit.r <- eBayes(fit.r)
  residuals <- residuals(fit.r, gsva_results)
  
  return(list(sig.result = sig.result, smoking.only = smoking.only, notch.only = notch.only, residuals = residuals))
}

plot_gsva_boxplot <- function(residuals, feature_labels, notch_status, smoking_status,
                              smoking_only, notch_only, facet_col){
  feature_ids <- names(feature_labels)
  
  bp.data <- data.frame(cbind(t(residuals), notch.status = notch_status, smoking.status = smoking_status))

  bp.data$notch.status <- factor(bp.data$notch.status, labels = c("WT","MT"))
  bp.data$smoking.status <- factor(bp.data$smoking.status, labels = c("Former","Current"))

  bp.sub <- bp.data[, c(feature_ids, "notch.status", "smoking.status")]
  
  meltData <- reshape2::melt(bp.sub, id.vars = c("notch.status", "smoking.status"))
  colnames(meltData)[colnames(meltData) == "variable"] <- facet_col
  meltData[[facet_col]] <- factor(meltData[[facet_col]], levels = feature_ids)
  
  gs_labeller <- as_labeller(feature_labels)
  
  df <- data.frame(id = feature_ids,
                   smoking_pval = paste("Smoking p_value:", format.pval(smoking_only[feature_ids,"adj.P.Val"], digits = 2)),
                   notch_pval = paste("NOTCH1 p_value: ", format.pval(notch_only[feature_ids,"adj.P.Val"], digits = 2))) |>
    tidyr::unite(p_value, smoking_pval:notch_pval, sep = "\n")
  colnames(df)[colnames(df) == "id"] <- facet_col
  
  df$y_max <- meltData |> group_by(.data[[facet_col]]) |> summarise(y = max(value)) |> pull(y)
  
  facet_formula <- as.formula(paste0("~", facet_col))
  
  gbox <- ggboxplot(meltData, x = "smoking.status", y = "value", fill = "notch.status", outlier.shape = NA, lwd = 0.35) +
    facet_wrap(facet_formula, scales = 'free', labeller = gs_labeller)  +
    geom_point(aes(fill = notch.status), position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.25, dodge.width = 0.75),
               size = 0.15) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.ticks.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 4, family = "Helvetica", color = "black"),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 5, vjust = 2.5, family = "Helvetica"),
          axis.ticks.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 4, family = "Helvetica", color = "black"),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 5, vjust = 2.5, family = "Helvetica"),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 6, family = "Helvetica"),
          strip.text = element_text(size = 5, family = "Helvetica", face = "bold"),
          plot.margin = unit(c(0,0,0,0.25), "cm"),
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 5, face = "bold"),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 4),
          legend.key.size = unit(0.5,"cm"),
          legend.position = "right", legend.box.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),
          legend.margin=margin(0,0,0,0),
          legend.spacing.x = unit(0.1, 'cm')) +
    theme(
      axis.line.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.line.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.3)
    ) + theme( panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
               panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "NOTCH1 status",values=c("orange","purple")) +
    xlab("Smoking Status") + ylab("GSVA Score")
  
  gbox +
    geom_text(data = df,
              mapping = aes(x = 1.5, y = y_max-0.1, label = p_value),
              size = 1.2, hjust = 0.7, vjust = 0, color = "black", fontface = "italic")
}
```

### GSVA: Epithelial Cell Signatures

```{r gsva-epithelial, fig.dpi=300, fig.cap="Figure 3H"}
celda_modules <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "Grants_celda_modules.rds"))

# CEACAM5   FOXJ1 SCGB1A1   KRT13    KRT5  MUC5AC
# "L33"    "L9"   "L37"   "L28"    "L5"   "L31"

epi <- run_gsva_model(exprData = data.cpm.filtered, geneSets = celda_modules$Ensembl_IDs,
                      design_full = design, design_reduced = design.r, pat_block = pat.block,
                      id_col = "Modules")
# Figure 3h
epi_labels <- c(L28 = "L28: Smoker Basal Cells\n(KRT13, SPRR1B)",
                L31 = "L31: Goblet Cells (MUC5AC)",
                L33 = "L33: Goblet/Peri-goblet cells\n(CEACAM5, CEACAM6)",
                L37 = "L37: Club Cells (SCGB1A1)")

g1 <- plot_gsva_boxplot(residuals = epi$residuals, feature_labels = epi_labels,
                        notch_status = notch.status, smoking_status = smoking.status,
                        smoking_only = epi$smoking.only, notch_only = epi$notch.only,
                        facet_col = "modules")
g1
```

### GSVA: Immune Cell Signatures

```{r gsva-immune, fig.dpi=300, fig.cap="Figure 3I"}
immune_signatures <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "immune_cell_signatures.rds"))

imm <- run_gsva_model(exprData = data.cpm.filtered, geneSets = immune_signatures,
                      design_full = design, design_reduced = design.r, pat_block = pat.block,
                      id_col = "Immune cells")
# figure 3i
immune_labels <- c(B_cells = "B-Cells",
                   T_cells = "T-Cells",
                   Neutrophils = "Neutrophils",
                   Th2_cells = "T Helper 2 (TH2) Cells")

g2 <- plot_gsva_boxplot(residuals = imm$residuals, feature_labels = immune_labels,
                        notch_status = notch.status, smoking_status = smoking.status,
                        smoking_only = imm$smoking.only, notch_only = imm$notch.only,
                        facet_col = "immune_cells")
g2
```
